2026_02_CIN_HOU.headline: Cincinnati’s protection challenge meets a Houston offense without Nico Collins
2026_02_CIN_HOU.paragraph1: Cincinnati brings Joe Burrow into a matchup where Houston’s edge duo can punish unstable protection, making the Bengals’ ability to stay on schedule central to the game. Houston must compensate for Nico Collins being ruled out with a hamstring injury, reducing C.J. Stroud’s most established perimeter option. The Texans need their remaining receivers and Dalton Schultz to create dependable answers, while Cincinnati must keep Will Anderson Jr. and Danielle Hunter from turning obvious passing downs into drive-ending pressure.
2026_02_CIN_HOU.model_rationale: The Bengals’ protection against Houston’s edge rush and the Texans’ redistribution of Collins’ targets are the clearest paths to controlling third downs and sustaining drives.
